parameters.query: SELECT p.id AS project_id, p.title, p.language, c.id AS chapter_id, c.chapter_number, c.title AS chapter_title, c.content, s.id AS scene_id, s.scene_number, s.title AS scene_title, s.summary, s.characters_present, s.location, s.time_period, s.emotional_tone FROM projects p JOIN chapters c ON p.id = c.project_id JOIN scenes s ON c.id = s.chapter_id WHERE p.id = $1 AND p.state = 'parsed' ORDER BY c.chapter_number, s.scene_number
INSERT INTO characters (project_id, name, aliases, role, description, first_appearance, created_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3::jsonb, $4, $5, $6, NOW())
INSERT INTO locations (project_id, name, type, description, significance, created_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, NOW())
UPDATE projects SET state = 'understood', intelligence_data = $2::jsonb, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1

values.value: ={{ JSON.stringify({ themes: $('Execute Logic (Scenes)').item.json.themes, narrative_structure: $('Execute Logic (Scenes)').item.json.narrative_structure, inconsistencies: $('Execute Logic (Scenes)').item.json.inconsistencies }) }}

parameters.query: INSERT INTO events (project_id, event_type, payload, created_at) VALUES ($1, 'story_understood', $2::jsonb, NOW())

values.value: ={{ JSON.stringify({ state: 'understood', characters_count: ($('Execute Logic (Scenes)').item.json.characters || []).length, locations_count: ($('Execute Logic (Scenes)').item.json.locations || []).length, themes: $('Execute Logic (Scenes)').item.json.themes }) }}
